title: Why bell pepper and onion Works So Well Together
flavorProfile: The crisp sweetness of bell pepper complements the mild pungency of onion, creating a balanced savory base with subtle sweet notes and a hint of umami from caramelized edges.
nutritionalSynergy: When consumed together, the vitamin C in bell peppers enhances the bioavailability of iron from onions, while the sulfur compounds in onions improve the absorption of carotenoids from peppers, synergistic micronutrient uptake.
prepTechniques: Slice bell peppers and onions uniformly to ensure even cooking.
Sauté onions first over medium heat until translucent, then add bell peppers and continue cooking until softened and lightly caramelized.
Season with salt, pepper, and optional herbs, then incorporate into dishes such as stir‑fries, sauces, or roasted vegetable medleys.

faq.a: Cool the cooked mixture to room temperature, then transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 3 days; for longer storage, freeze in portion‑size bags for up to 2 months.
Yes; red or yellow bell peppers can replace green peppers, and shallots or leeks can substitute onions, though flavor nuances will differ.
